title: Uniqueness of an fpqc amalgamation
statement: Let k be a field, f:C to Spec k a smooth proper geometrically integral curve, d an integer, and S the fibrewise-degree-d subfunctor [lem-pd-degree-locally-constant]. For an fpqc sieve R on T and a compatible family x of sections of its fppf sheafification, any two amalgamations are equal.

proof.text: Use the universally trivial direct image for a smooth proper geometrically integral curve to apply isSeparated_fpqc_picardFunctor. Left exact fppf sheafification preserves the monomorphism from the degree subfunctor into the Picard presheaf. Hence the sheafification of that subfunctor is fpqc-separated by Presieve.IsSeparatedFor.of_mono. Apply this separatedness to the two given amalgamations. The degree criterion and compatibility hypothesis are unnecessary for uniqueness; their signatures are retained.

proof_origin.place: Agent adaptation of Tags 0D27 and 023T and the existing ratio-cocycle Lean argument

theorem unique_amalgamation_fpqc_sheafify_picardDegree
    {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Scheme.{u}} (f : C ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 f] [IsProper f] [GeometricallyIntegral f]
    (d : ℤ) (S : Subfunctor (picardPresheaf f))
    (hS : ∀ (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (L : (picardPresheaf f).obj (op T)),
      L ∈ S.obj (op T) ↔ ∀ t, picardPresheafDegree f L t = d)
    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (R : Sieve T)
    (hR : R ∈ (Scheme.fpqcTopology.over (Spec (.of k))) T)
    (x : Presieve.FamilyOfElements
      ((presheafToSheaf (Scheme.fppfTopology.over (Spec (.of k))) (Type (u + 1))).obj
        S.toFunctor).obj R.arrows)
    (hx : x.Compatible) {t₁ t₂ : _}
    (h₁ : x.IsAmalgamation t₁) (h₂ : x.IsAmalgamation t₂) :
    t₁ = t₂
